title: When Clients Ask About Quantum, Will Their Lawyers Be Ready?
content_md: Ralph Losey discusses the emerging legal challenges posed by quantum computing in confidentiality, contracts, and evidence. Lawyers must prepare to address clients’ concerns about data security and post-quantum encryption without needing deep physics knowledge. Interdisciplinary collaboration is crucial for identifying legal issues and ensuring proper risk management as quantum technology develops. Article Link: Navigating Legal Issues in the Quantum Computing Era
